-- depends_on: {{ ref('gold_drive_telemetry') }}

WITH drive_stats AS (
    SELECT
        vehicle_id,
        drive_id,
        MIN(event_date) AS drive_date,
        MIN(sampled_at_ts) AS start_timestamp,
        MAX(sampled_at_ts) AS end_timestamp,
        MAX(elapsed_drive_time_s) AS duration_seconds,
        ARG_MAX(speed_source_mode, sampled_at_ts) AS speed_telemetry_mode
    FROM (
        SELECT
            vehicle_id,
            drive_id,
            event_date,
            TRY_CAST(sampled_at AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AS sampled_at_ts,
            elapsed_drive_time_s,
            speed_source_mode
        FROM delta_scan('{{ var("gold_telemetry_uri") }}')
    )
    GROUP BY vehicle_id, drive_id
)
SELECT
    md5(vehicle_id || '|' || drive_id) AS drive_meta_key,
    vehicle_id,
    drive_id,
    drive_date,
    dayofweek(drive_date) AS day_of_week,
    CASE
        WHEN hour(start_timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Warsaw') BETWEEN 5 AND 11
            THEN 'Morning'
        WHEN hour(start_timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Warsaw') BETWEEN 12 AND 16
            THEN 'Afternoon'
        WHEN hour(start_timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Warsaw') BETWEEN 17 AND 21
            THEN 'Evening'
        ELSE 'Night'
    END AS time_of_day_bucket,
    start_timestamp,
    end_timestamp,
    duration_seconds,
    CASE
        WHEN duration_seconds < 300 THEN 'Repark / Micro-Trip (<5 min)'
        WHEN duration_seconds <= 900 THEN 'Short Trip (5-15 min)'
        WHEN duration_seconds <= 2700 THEN 'Standard Trip (15-45 min)'
        ELSE 'Long Session (>45 min)'
    END AS trip_duration_category,
    duration_seconds < 300 AS is_repark_or_micro_trip_flag,
    CASE speed_telemetry_mode
        WHEN 'DUAL_ACTIVE' THEN 'Dual Sensor (ECU VSS + GPS)'
        WHEN 'GPS_ONLY' THEN 'GPS Speed Only (ECU VSS=0)'
        WHEN 'ECU_VSS_ONLY' THEN 'ECU VSS Only (No GPS)'
        ELSE 'No Valid Speed Sensor'
    END AS speed_telemetry_mode
FROM drive_stats

{{

        delta_merge_options={
            'location': var('gold_dim_fuel_profile_uri'),
            'key_columns': ['fuel_profile_key']
        }
    )
}}

-- depends_on: {{ ref('gold_drive_telemetry') }}

WITH fuel_trim_inputs AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        AVG(stft_bank_1) FILTER (
            WHERE rpm >= 500 AND COALESCE(dfco_active, 0) = 0
        ) OVER (PARTITION BY vehicle_id, drive_id) AS avg_stft_bank_1,
        AVG(ltft_bank_1) FILTER (
            WHERE rpm >= 500 AND COALESCE(dfco_active, 0) = 0
        ) OVER (PARTITION BY vehicle_id, drive_id) AS avg_ltft_bank_1,
        AVG(ego_cor1) FILTER (
            WHERE rpm >= 500 AND COALESCE(dfco_active, 0) = 0
        ) OVER (PARTITION BY vehicle_id, drive_id) AS avg_ego_cor1,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE rpm >= 500
              AND COALESCE(dfco_active, 0) = 0
              AND stft_bank_1 IS NOT NULL
              AND stft_bank_1 NOT IN (0.0, 100.0)
        ) OVER (PARTITION BY vehicle_id, drive_id) AS non_sentinel_stft_sample_count
    FROM delta_scan('{{ var("gold_telemetry_uri") }}')
),
fuel_trim_normalized AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        CASE
            WHEN stft_bank_1 IS NULL THEN 0.0
            WHEN avg_stft_bank_1 BETWEEN 50.0 AND 150.0
                THEN stft_bank_1 - 100.0
            WHEN avg_stft_bank_1 BETWEEN 0.5 AND 1.5
                THEN (stft_bank_1 - 1.0) * 100.0
            ELSE stft_bank_1
        END AS stft_deviation_pct,
        CASE
            WHEN ltft_bank_1 IS NULL THEN 0.0
            WHEN avg_ltft_bank_1 BETWEEN 50.0 AND 150.0
                THEN ltft_bank_1 - 100.0
            WHEN avg_ltft_bank_1 BETWEEN 0.5 AND 1.5
                THEN (ltft_bank_1 - 1.0) * 100.0
            ELSE ltft_bank_1
        END AS ltft_deviation_pct,
        CASE
            WHEN ego_cor1 IS NULL THEN 0.0
            WHEN avg_ego_cor1 BETWEEN 50.0 AND 150.0
                THEN ego_cor1 - 100.0
            WHEN avg_ego_cor1 BETWEEN 0.5 AND 1.5
                THEN (ego_cor1 - 1.0) * 100.0
            ELSE ego_cor1
        END AS ego_deviation_pct
    FROM fuel_trim_inputs
),
drive_fuel AS (
    SELECT
        vehicle_id,
        drive_id,
        MAX(cumulative_drive_distance_km) AS total_distance_km,
        MAX(fuel_total_consumed) - MIN(fuel_total_consumed) AS measured_fuel_g,
        SUM(fuel_flow_rate * dt_s) / 750.0 AS integrated_fuel_l,
        CASE
            WHEN MAX(non_sentinel_stft_sample_count) = 0
                THEN AVG(ABS(ego_deviation_pct)) FILTER (
                    WHERE rpm >= 500 AND COALESCE(dfco_active, 0) = 0
                )
            ELSE AVG(ABS(stft_deviation_pct + ltft_deviation_pct)) FILTER (
                WHERE rpm >= 500 AND COALESCE(dfco_active, 0) = 0
            )
        END AS avg_abs_fuel_trim_pct,
        AVG(effective_speed_kmh) AS avg_speed_kmh,
        AVG(tps) AS avg_tps_pct,
        SUM(CASE WHEN is_clean_wot_pull THEN COALESCE(dt_s, 0) ELSE 0 END)
            * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(COALESCE(dt_s, 0)), 0) AS wot_time_pct
    FROM fuel_trim_normalized
    GROUP BY vehicle_id, drive_id
),
profile AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        COALESCE(NULLIF(measured_fuel_g, 0) / 750.0, integrated_fuel_l)
            AS total_fuel_consumed_l,
        COALESCE(NULLIF(measured_fuel_g, 0) / 750.0, integrated_fuel_l)
            / NULLIF(total_distance_km, 0) * 100.0 AS fuel_consumption_l_100km
    FROM drive_fuel
)
SELECT
    md5(vehicle_id || '|' || drive_id) AS fuel_profile_key,
    vehicle_id,
    drive_id,
    CASE
        WHEN total_distance_km < 0.2 OR fuel_consumption_l_100km IS NULL
            THEN 'Stationary / N/A'
        WHEN fuel_consumption_l_100km < 8 THEN '<8 L/100km'
        WHEN fuel_consumption_l_100km < 12 THEN '8-12 L/100km'
        WHEN fuel_consumption_l_100km < 18 THEN '12-18 L/100km'
        ELSE '>18 L/100km'
    END AS consumption_band,
    CASE
        WHEN wot_time_pct >= 20 OR avg_tps_pct >= 55 THEN 'Track / WOT Heavy'
        WHEN avg_tps_pct >= 35 OR avg_speed_kmh >= 60 THEN 'Spirited / Boost'
        WHEN avg_tps_pct < 20 AND avg_speed_kmh >= 25 THEN 'Eco / Cruise'
        ELSE 'Mixed Street'
    END AS driving_style_category,
    CASE
        WHEN avg_abs_fuel_trim_pct < 3 THEN 'Well Tuned (<3% trim)'
        WHEN avg_abs_fuel_trim_pct <= 8 THEN 'Moderate Correction (3-8% trim)'
        ELSE 'Needs Retune (>8% trim)'
    END AS afr_tuning_health_band
FROM profile

model.dbt_cloudmetry.dim_thermal_profile.description: Per-drive engine warmup, thermal completion, and oil-pressure profile.
model.dbt_cloudmetry.dim_thermal_profile.raw_code:
{{
    config(
        materialized='external',
        plugin='delta_merge',
        format='parquet',
        location=var('dbt_staging_uri') ~ '/' ~ var('batch_id') ~ '_dim_thermal_profile.parquet',
        options={},
        delta_merge_options={
            'location': var('gold_dim_thermal_profile_uri'),
            'key_columns': ['thermal_profile_key']
        }
    )
}}

-- depends_on: {{ ref('gold_drive_telemetry') }}

WITH telemetry AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM delta_scan('{{ var("gold_telemetry_uri") }}')
),
warmup_cutoffs AS (
    SELECT
        vehicle_id,
        drive_id,
        COALESCE(
            MIN(sampled_at) FILTER (WHERE clt >= 85 AND oil_temp >= 82),
            MAX(sampled_at)
        ) AS warmup_complete_timestamp,
        COALESCE(
            ARG_MIN(clt, sampled_at) FILTER (
                WHERE clt BETWEEN -35.0 AND 150.0 AND rpm >= 500
            ),
            ARG_MIN(clt, sampled_at) FILTER (WHERE clt BETWEEN -35.0 AND 150.0)
        ) AS start_clt_c,
        COALESCE(
            ARG_MIN(oil_temp, sampled_at) FILTER (
                WHERE oil_temp BETWEEN -35.0 AND 150.0 AND rpm >= 500
            ),
            ARG_MIN(oil_temp, sampled_at)
                FILTER (WHERE oil_temp BETWEEN -35.0 AND 150.0)
        ) AS start_oil_temp_c
    FROM telemetry
    GROUP BY vehicle_id, drive_id
),
telemetry_with_warmup AS (
    SELECT
        telemetry.*,
        telemetry.sampled_at <= warmup_cutoffs.warmup_complete_timestamp
            AND NOT (
                COALESCE(warmup_cutoffs.start_clt_c >= 85, FALSE)
                AND COALESCE(warmup_cutoffs.start_oil_temp_c >= 82, FALSE)
            ) AS is_before_warmup_complete
    FROM telemetry
    INNER JOIN warmup_cutoffs USING (vehicle_id, drive_id)
),
drive_thermal AS (
    SELECT
        vehicle_id,
        drive_id,
        COALESCE(
            ARG_MIN(clt, sampled_at) FILTER (
                WHERE clt BETWEEN -35.0 AND 150.0 AND rpm >= 500
            ),
            ARG_MIN(clt, sampled_at) FILTER (WHERE clt BETWEEN -35.0 AND 150.0)
        ) AS start_clt_c,
        COALESCE(
            ARG_MIN(oil_temp, sampled_at) FILTER (
                WHERE oil_temp BETWEEN -35.0 AND 150.0 AND rpm >= 500
            ),
            ARG_MIN(oil_temp, sampled_at)
                FILTER (WHERE oil_temp BETWEEN -35.0 AND 150.0)
        ) AS start_oil_temp_c,
        MAX(clt) AS max_clt_c,
        MAX(oil_temp) AS max_oil_temp_c,
        MAX(mat) AS max_mat_c,
        MIN(oil_pressure / 100.0) FILTER (
            WHERE oil_temp >= 82.0
              AND is_active_engine_window
              AND rpm >= 650
              AND oil_pressure / 100.0 > 0.1
        )
            AS min_hot_oil_pressure_bar,
        MIN(oil_pressure_per_1k_rpm_bar) FILTER (
            WHERE is_active_engine_window AND rpm BETWEEN 1500 AND 4000
        ) AS min_oil_pressure_per_1k_rpm_bar,
        MIN(oil_pressure_safety_margin_bar) FILTER (
            WHERE is_active_engine_window AND rpm >= 650
        )
            AS min_oil_pressure_safety_margin_bar,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE is_low_oil_pressure_for_rpm
              AND ABS(imu_lateral_accel_g) >= 0.35
        ) AS oil_starvation_in_cornering_samples_count,
        CASE
            WHEN COALESCE(
                SUM(dt_s) FILTER (WHERE is_low_oil_pressure_for_rpm),
                0.0
            ) >= 0.15
              OR COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_low_oil_pressure_for_rpm) >= 3
                THEN TRUE
            ELSE FALSE
        END AS low_oil_pressure_damage_risk_flag,
        AVG(effective_speed_kmh) FILTER (WHERE is_before_warmup_complete)
            AS warmup_avg_speed_kmh,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE is_before_warmup_complete AND effective_speed_kmh < 5
        ) * 100.0 / NULLIF(
            COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_before_warmup_complete), 0
        )
            AS warmup_traffic_or_idle_time_pct,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE is_before_warmup_complete
              AND effective_speed_kmh >= 40 AND tps < 50
        ) * 100.0 / NULLIF(
            COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_before_warmup_complete), 0
        )
            AS warmup_cruise_time_pct,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE is_before_warmup_complete
              AND (tps >= 60 OR map >= 110 OR rpm >= 4000)
        ) * 100.0 / NULLIF(
            COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_before_warmup_complete), 0
        )
            AS warmup_high_load_time_pct,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE is_before_warmup_complete
              AND (clt < 75 OR oil_temp < 75)
              AND (rpm >= 4500 OR map >= 130 OR tps >= 80)
        ) AS cold_engine_abuse_samples_count
    FROM telemetry_with_warmup
    GROUP BY vehicle_id, drive_id
)
SELECT
    md5(vehicle_id || '|' || drive_id) AS thermal_profile_key,
    vehicle_id,
    drive_id,
    CASE
        WHEN start_clt_c >= 85 AND start_oil_temp_c >= 82
            THEN 'Started Pre-Warmed (CLT>=85C & Oil>=82C)'
        WHEN warmup_high_load_time_pct > 15 OR cold_engine_abuse_samples_count > 10
            THEN 'Aggressive / High-Load Cold Warmup'
        WHEN warmup_traffic_or_idle_time_pct >= 50 OR warmup_avg_speed_kmh < 15
            THEN 'Traffic Jam / Stationary Idle Warmup'
        WHEN warmup_cruise_time_pct >= 40 OR warmup_avg_speed_kmh >= 45
            THEN 'Gentle Steady Cruising Warmup'
        ELSE 'Mixed Urban Warmup'
    END AS warmup_driving_style_category,
    CASE
        WHEN max_clt_c IS NULL AND max_oil_temp_c IS NULL THEN 'Unknown'
        WHEN max_clt_c >= 85 AND max_oil_temp_c >= 82
            THEN 'Fully Warmed (CLT>=85C & Oil>=82C)'
        WHEN max_clt_c >= 85 AND COALESCE(max_oil_temp_c, 0) < 82
            THEN 'Coolant Only Warmed (CLT>=85C, Oil<82C)'
        ELSE 'Under-Warmed Short Trip (CLT<85C & Oil<82C)'
    END AS thermal_completion_status,
    CASE
        WHEN max_mat_c IS NULL THEN 'Unknown'
        WHEN max_mat_c < 25 THEN 'Cool Intake (MAT < 25C)'
        WHEN max_mat_c <= 45 THEN 'Moderate Intake (25-45C)'
        ELSE 'Severe Heat Soak (MAT > 45C)'
    END AS intake_heat_soak_regime,
    CASE
        WHEN oil_starvation_in_cornering_samples_count >= 3
            THEN 'CRITICAL: Cornering Oil Starvation (Lateral G Slosh)'
        WHEN low_oil_pressure_damage_risk_flag
            THEN 'CRITICAL: Below Safe Pressure-vs-RPM Curve (<1.0 bar idle / <3.2 bar load)'
        WHEN min_oil_pressure_safety_margin_bar < 0.25
          OR min_oil_pressure_per_1k_rpm_bar < 0.80
            THEN 'WARNING: Thin Safety Margin (<0.25 bar above RPM floor or ratio <0.80)'
        ELSE 'Healthy Oil Pressure Curve'
    END AS oil_pressure_health_status
FROM drive_thermal

        telemetry.*,
        telemetry.sampled_at <= warmup_cutoffs.warmup_complete_timestamp
            AND NOT (
                COALESCE(warmup_cutoffs.start_clt_c >= 85, FALSE)
                AND COALESCE(warmup_cutoffs.start_oil_temp_c >= 82, FALSE)
            ) AS is_before_warmup_complete
    FROM telemetry
    INNER JOIN warmup_cutoffs USING (vehicle_id, drive_id)
),
drive_thermal AS (
    SELECT
        vehicle_id,
        drive_id,
        COALESCE(
            ARG_MIN(clt, sampled_at) FILTER (
                WHERE clt BETWEEN -35.0 AND 150.0 AND rpm >= 500
            ),
            ARG_MIN(clt, sampled_at) FILTER (WHERE clt BETWEEN -35.0 AND 150.0)
        ) AS start_clt_c,
        COALESCE(
            ARG_MIN(oil_temp, sampled_at) FILTER (
                WHERE oil_temp BETWEEN -35.0 AND 150.0 AND rpm >= 500
            ),
            ARG_MIN(oil_temp, sampled_at)
                FILTER (WHERE oil_temp BETWEEN -35.0 AND 150.0)
        ) AS start_oil_temp_c,
        MAX(clt) AS max_clt_c,
        MAX(oil_temp) AS max_oil_temp_c,
        MAX(mat) AS max_mat_c,
        MIN(oil_pressure / 100.0) FILTER (
            WHERE oil_temp >= 82.0
              AND is_active_engine_window
              AND rpm >= 650
              AND oil_pressure / 100.0 > 0.1
        )
            AS min_hot_oil_pressure_bar,
        MIN(oil_pressure_per_1k_rpm_bar) FILTER (
            WHERE is_active_engine_window AND rpm BETWEEN 1500 AND 4000
        ) AS min_oil_pressure_per_1k_rpm_bar,
        MIN(oil_pressure_safety_margin_bar) FILTER (
            WHERE is_active_engine_window AND rpm >= 650
        )
            AS min_oil_pressure_safety_margin_bar,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE is_low_oil_pressure_for_rpm
              AND ABS(imu_lateral_accel_g) >= 0.35
        ) AS oil_starvation_in_cornering_samples_count,
        CASE
            WHEN COALESCE(
                SUM(dt_s) FILTER (WHERE is_low_oil_pressure_for_rpm),
                0.0
            ) >= 0.15
              OR COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_low_oil_pressure_for_rpm) >= 3
                THEN TRUE
            ELSE FALSE
        END AS low_oil_pressure_damage_risk_flag,
        AVG(effective_speed_kmh) FILTER (WHERE is_before_warmup_complete)
            AS warmup_avg_speed_kmh,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE is_before_warmup_complete AND effective_speed_kmh < 5
        ) * 100.0 / NULLIF(
            COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_before_warmup_complete), 0
        )
            AS warmup_traffic_or_idle_time_pct,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE is_before_warmup_complete
              AND effective_speed_kmh >= 40 AND tps < 50
        ) * 100.0 / NULLIF(
            COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_before_warmup_complete), 0
        )
            AS warmup_cruise_time_pct,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE is_before_warmup_complete
              AND (tps >= 60 OR map >= 110 OR rpm >= 4000)
        ) * 100.0 / NULLIF(
            COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_before_warmup_complete), 0
        )
            AS warmup_high_load_time_pct,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE is_before_warmup_complete
              AND (clt < 75 OR oil_temp < 75)
              AND (rpm >= 4500 OR map >= 130 OR tps >= 80)
        ) AS cold_engine_abuse_samples_count
    FROM telemetry_with_warmup
    GROUP BY vehicle_id, drive_id
)
SELECT
    md5(vehicle_id || '|' || drive_id) AS thermal_profile_key,
    vehicle_id,
    drive_id,
    CASE
        WHEN start_clt_c >= 85 AND start_oil_temp_c >= 82
            THEN 'Started Pre-Warmed (CLT>=85C & Oil>=82C)'
        WHEN warmup_high_load_time_pct > 15 OR cold_engine_abuse_samples_count > 10
            THEN 'Aggressive / High-Load Cold Warmup'
        WHEN warmup_traffic_or_idle_time_pct >= 50 OR warmup_avg_speed_kmh < 15
            THEN 'Traffic Jam / Stationary Idle Warmup'
        WHEN warmup_cruise_time_pct >= 40 OR warmup_avg_speed_kmh >= 45
            THEN 'Gentle Steady Cruising Warmup'
        ELSE 'Mixed Urban Warmup'
    END AS warmup_driving_style_category,
    CASE
        WHEN max_clt_c IS NULL AND max_oil_temp_c IS NULL THEN 'Unknown'
        WHEN max_clt_c >= 85 AND max_oil_temp_c >= 82
            THEN 'Fully Warmed (CLT>=85C & Oil>=82C)'
        WHEN max_clt_c >= 85 AND COALESCE(max_oil_temp_c, 0) < 82
            THEN 'Coolant Only Warmed (CLT>=85C, Oil<82C)'
        ELSE 'Under-Warmed Short Trip (CLT<85C & Oil<82C)'
    END AS thermal_completion_status,
    CASE
        WHEN max_mat_c IS NULL THEN 'Unknown'
        WHEN max_mat_c < 25 THEN 'Cool Intake (MAT < 25C)'
        WHEN max_mat_c <= 45 THEN 'Moderate Intake (25-45C)'
        ELSE 'Severe Heat Soak (MAT > 45C)'
    END AS intake_heat_soak_regime,
    CASE
        WHEN oil_starvation_in_cornering_samples_count >= 3
            THEN 'CRITICAL: Cornering Oil Starvation (Lateral G Slosh)'
        WHEN low_oil_pressure_damage_risk_flag
            THEN 'CRITICAL: Below Safe Pressure-vs-RPM Curve (<1.0 bar idle / <3.2 bar load)'
        WHEN min_oil_pressure_safety_margin_bar < 0.25
          OR min_oil_pressure_per_1k_rpm_bar < 0.80
            THEN 'WARNING: Thin Safety Margin (<0.25 bar above RPM floor or ratio <0.80)'
        ELSE 'Healthy Oil Pressure Curve'
    END AS oil_pressure_health_status
FROM drive_thermal

WITH telemetry AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM delta_scan('{{ var("gold_telemetry_uri") }}')
),
warmup_cutoffs AS (
    SELECT
        vehicle_id,
        drive_id,
        COALESCE(
            MIN(sampled_at) FILTER (WHERE clt >= 85 AND oil_temp >= 82),
            MAX(sampled_at)
        ) AS warmup_complete_timestamp,
        COALESCE(
            ARG_MIN(clt, sampled_at) FILTER (
                WHERE clt BETWEEN -35.0 AND 150.0 AND rpm >= 500
            ),
            ARG_MIN(clt, sampled_at) FILTER (WHERE clt BETWEEN -35.0 AND 150.0)
        ) AS start_clt_c,
        COALESCE(
            ARG_MIN(oil_temp, sampled_at) FILTER (
                WHERE oil_temp BETWEEN -35.0 AND 150.0 AND rpm >= 500
            ),
            ARG_MIN(oil_temp, sampled_at)
                FILTER (WHERE oil_temp BETWEEN -35.0 AND 150.0)
        ) AS start_oil_temp_c
    FROM telemetry
    GROUP BY vehicle_id, drive_id
),
telemetry_with_warmup AS (
    SELECT
        telemetry.*,
        telemetry.sampled_at <= warmup_cutoffs.warmup_complete_timestamp
            AND NOT (
                COALESCE(warmup_cutoffs.start_clt_c >= 85, FALSE)
                AND COALESCE(warmup_cutoffs.start_oil_temp_c >= 82, FALSE)
            )
            AS is_before_warmup_complete
    FROM telemetry
    INNER JOIN warmup_cutoffs USING (vehicle_id, drive_id)
),
gear_steps AS (
    SELECT
        vehicle_id,
        drive_id,
        detected_gear,
        LAG(detected_gear) OVER (
            PARTITION BY vehicle_id, drive_id ORDER BY sampled_at
        ) AS previous_gear
    FROM telemetry
    WHERE detected_gear BETWEEN 1 AND 6
      AND effective_speed_kmh > 5.0
),
gear_stats AS (
    SELECT
        vehicle_id,
        drive_id,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE detected_gear IS NOT NULL
              AND previous_gear IS NOT NULL
              AND detected_gear <> previous_gear
        ) AS gear_shifts_count
    FROM gear_steps
    GROUP BY vehicle_id, drive_id
),
rev_limit_steps AS (
    SELECT
        vehicle_id,
        drive_id,
        rev_limit_active,
        LAG(rev_limit_active) OVER (
            PARTITION BY vehicle_id, drive_id ORDER BY sampled_at
        ) AS previous_rev_limit_active
    FROM telemetry
),
rev_limit_stats AS (
    SELECT
        vehicle_id,
        drive_id,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE rev_limit_active = 1
              AND COALESCE(previous_rev_limit_active, 0) <> 1
        ) AS rev_limit_events_count
    FROM rev_limit_steps
    GROUP BY vehicle_id, drive_id
),
weather_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        vehicle_id,
        drive_id,
        SUM(weather_precipitation_mm) AS total_precipitation_mm,
        AVG(weather_temp_c) AS avg_ambient_temp_c,
        AVG(weather_wind_speed_ms) AS avg_wind_speed_ms
    FROM (
        SELECT
            vehicle_id,
            drive_id,
            weather_hour_bucket,
            AVG(weather_precipitation_mm) AS weather_precipitation_mm,
            AVG(weather_temp_c) AS weather_temp_c,
            AVG(weather_wind_speed_ms) AS weather_wind_speed_ms
        FROM telemetry
        WHERE weather_hour_bucket IS NOT NULL
        GROUP BY vehicle_id, drive_id, weather_hour_bucket
    )
    GROUP BY vehicle_id, drive_id
),
drive_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        vehicle_id,
        drive_id,
        MIN(sampled_at) AS start_timestamp,
        MAX(sampled_at) AS end_timestamp,
        MAX(elapsed_drive_time_s) AS duration_seconds,
        MAX(cumulative_drive_distance_km) AS total_distance_km,
        MAX(fuel_total_consumed) - MIN(fuel_total_consumed)
            AS total_fuel_consumed_g,
        (MAX(fuel_total_consumed) - MIN(fuel_total_consumed)) / 750.0
            AS measured_fuel_l,
        SUM(fuel_flow_rate * dt_s) / 750.0 AS integrated_fuel_l,
        ARG_MIN(warning_last, sampled_at)
            FILTER (WHERE warning_last > 0) AS first_warning_code,
        ARG_MAX(warning_last, sampled_at)
            FILTER (WHERE warning_last > 0) AS last_warning_code,
        ARG_MAX(stop_engine_code, sampled_at)
            FILTER (WHERE stop_engine_code > 0) AS stop_engine_code_key_raw,
        MODE(ign_cut_code) FILTER (WHERE ign_cut_code > 0)
            AS dominant_ign_cut_code_raw,
        MODE(fuel_cut_code) FILTER (WHERE fuel_cut_code > 0)
            AS dominant_fuel_cut_code_raw,
        list_sort(list_distinct(list_concat(
            list(CAST(warning_last AS INTEGER))
                FILTER (WHERE warning_last > 0),
            list(CAST(stop_engine_code AS INTEGER))
                FILTER (WHERE stop_engine_code > 0),
            list(CAST(ign_cut_code AS INTEGER))
                FILTER (WHERE ign_cut_code > 0),
            list(CAST(fuel_cut_code AS INTEGER))
                FILTER (WHERE fuel_cut_code > 0)
        ))) AS error_codes,
        MIN(sampled_at) FILTER (WHERE warning_last > 0) AS first_warning_timestamp,
        MAX(warning_counter) - MIN(warning_counter) AS total_warnings_delta,
        MAX(trigger_error_counter) - MIN(trigger_error_counter)
            AS trigger_errors_delta,
        COALESCE(SUM(dt_s) FILTER (WHERE rev_limit_active = 1), 0.0)
            AS rev_limit_active_duration_s,
        MAX(check_engine) AS check_engine_triggered_flag,
        MAX(total_spark_cut) - MIN(total_spark_cut) AS total_spark_cuts_delta,
        MAX(total_fuel_cut) - MIN(total_fuel_cut) AS total_fuel_cuts_delta,
        MAX(cpu_usage_percent) AS max_cpu_usage_pct,
        AVG(cpu_usage_percent) AS avg_cpu_usage_pct,
        MAX(analog_sensors_supply_failure) AS analog_supply_failure_flag,

        COALESCE(
            ARG_MIN(clt, sampled_at) FILTER (
                WHERE clt BETWEEN -35.0 AND 150.0 AND rpm >= 500
            ),
            ARG_MIN(clt, sampled_at) FILTER (WHERE clt BETWEEN -35.0 AND 150.0)
        ) AS start_clt_c,
        COALESCE(
            ARG_MIN(oil_temp, sampled_at) FILTER (
                WHERE oil_temp BETWEEN -35.0 AND 150.0 AND rpm >= 500
            ),
            ARG_MIN(oil_temp, sampled_at)
                FILTER (WHERE oil_temp BETWEEN -35.0 AND 150.0)
        ) AS start_oil_temp_c,
        MAX(clt) AS max_clt_c,
        MIN(clt) FILTER (WHERE clt > -35.0) AS min_clt_c,
        AVG(clt) AS avg_clt_c,
        AVG(clt) FILTER (WHERE clt > 87.0) AS avg_hot_clt_c,
        COALESCE(
            ARG_MAX(clt, sampled_at) FILTER (
                WHERE clt BETWEEN -35.0 AND 150.0 AND rpm >= 500
            ),
            ARG_MAX(clt, sampled_at) FILTER (WHERE clt BETWEEN -35.0 AND 150.0)
        ) AS end_clt_c,
        MAX(oil_temp) AS max_oil_temp_c,
        MIN(oil_temp) FILTER (WHERE oil_temp > -35.0) AS min_oil_temp_c,
        AVG(oil_temp) AS avg_oil_temp_c,
        AVG(oil_temp) FILTER (WHERE oil_temp > 90.0) AS avg_hot_oil_temp_c,
        COALESCE(
            ARG_MAX(oil_temp, sampled_at) FILTER (
                WHERE oil_temp BETWEEN -35.0 AND 150.0 AND rpm >= 500
            ),
            ARG_MAX(oil_temp, sampled_at)
                FILTER (WHERE oil_temp BETWEEN -35.0 AND 150.0)
        ) AS end_oil_temp_c,
        MAX(mat) AS max_mat_c,
        AVG(mat) AS avg_mat_c,
        AVG(mat) FILTER (WHERE is_clean_wot_pull) AS wot_avg_mat_c,
        MAX(air_charge_temperature_estimate) AS max_charge_temp_est_c,
        AVG(air_charge_temperature_estimate) AS avg_charge_temp_est_c,
        AVG(intercooler_heat_soak_delta_c) AS intercooler_heat_soak_avg_c,
        MAX(intercooler_heat_soak_delta_c) AS intercooler_heat_soak_max_c,
        MAX(mat) FILTER (WHERE rpm >= 500) - MIN(mat) FILTER (WHERE rpm >= 500)
            AS mat_thermal_rise_c,
        MIN(oil_pressure / 100.0) FILTER (
            WHERE oil_temp >= 82.0
              AND is_active_engine_window
              AND rpm >= 650
              AND oil_pressure / 100.0 > 0.1
        )
            AS min_hot_oil_pressure_bar,
        MIN(oil_pressure / 100.0) FILTER (
            WHERE oil_temp >= 82.0
              AND is_active_engine_window
              AND rpm >= 3000
              AND oil_pressure / 100.0 > 0.1
        ) AS min_hot_load_oil_pressure_bar,
        MIN(oil_pressure / 100.0) FILTER (
            WHERE is_active_engine_window
              AND oil_temp >= 80.0
              AND rpm BETWEEN 650 AND 1250
              AND oil_pressure / 100.0 > 0.1
        ) AS min_hot_idle_oil_pressure_bar,
        MIN(oil_pressure_per_1k_rpm_bar) FILTER (
            WHERE is_active_engine_window AND rpm BETWEEN 1500 AND 4000
        ) AS min_oil_pressure_per_1k_rpm_bar,
        AVG(oil_pressure_per_1k_rpm_bar) FILTER (
            WHERE is_active_engine_window AND rpm BETWEEN 1500 AND 4000
        ) AS avg_oil_pressure_per_1k_rpm_bar,
        MIN(oil_pressure_safety_margin_bar) FILTER (
            WHERE is_active_engine_window AND rpm >= 650
        )
            AS min_oil_pressure_safety_margin_bar,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_low_oil_pressure_for_rpm)
            AS low_oil_pressure_samples_count,
        COALESCE(SUM(dt_s) FILTER (WHERE is_low_oil_pressure_for_rpm), 0.0)
            AS low_oil_pressure_duration_s,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE is_low_oil_pressure_for_rpm
              AND ABS(imu_lateral_accel_g) >= 0.35
        ) AS oil_starvation_in_cornering_samples_count,
        CASE
            WHEN COALESCE(
                SUM(dt_s) FILTER (WHERE is_low_oil_pressure_for_rpm),
                0.0
            ) >= 0.15
              OR COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_low_oil_pressure_for_rpm) >= 3
                THEN TRUE
            ELSE FALSE
        END AS low_oil_pressure_damage_risk_flag,
        AVG(oil_pressure / 100.0) FILTER (
            WHERE is_active_engine_window
              AND rpm >= 650
              AND oil_pressure / 100.0 > 0.1
        ) AS avg_oil_pressure_bar,
        MAX(oil_pressure / 100.0) FILTER (
            WHERE is_active_engine_window
              AND rpm >= 650
              AND oil_pressure / 100.0 > 0.1
        ) AS max_oil_pressure_bar,
        MIN(batt_v) FILTER (WHERE rpm >= 500 AND batt_v > 5.0) AS min_batt_v,
        AVG(batt_v) FILTER (WHERE rpm >= 500 AND batt_v > 5.0) AS avg_batt_v,
        MAX(batt_v) AS max_batt_v,
        MAX(ecu_cpu_temperature) AS max_ecu_cpu_temp_c,
        AVG(ecu_cpu_temperature) AS avg_ecu_cpu_temp_c,
        MIN(elapsed_drive_time_s) FILTER (WHERE clt >= 85)
            AS first_clt_85_time_s,
        MIN(cumulative_drive_distance_km) FILTER (WHERE clt >= 85)
            AS first_clt_85_distance_km,
        MIN(elapsed_drive_time_s) FILTER (WHERE oil_temp >= 82)
            AS first_oil_82_time_s,
        MIN(cumulative_drive_distance_km) FILTER (WHERE oil_temp >= 82)
            AS first_oil_82_distance_km,
        AVG(rpm) FILTER (WHERE is_before_warmup_complete) AS warmup_avg_rpm,
        MAX(rpm) FILTER (WHERE is_before_warmup_complete) AS warmup_max_rpm,
        AVG(map) FILTER (WHERE is_before_warmup_complete)
            AS warmup_avg_map_kpa,
        AVG(tps) FILTER (WHERE is_before_warmup_complete)
            AS warmup_avg_tps_pct,
        AVG(effective_speed_kmh) FILTER (WHERE is_before_warmup_complete)
            AS warmup_avg_speed_kmh,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE is_before_warmup_complete AND effective_speed_kmh < 5
        ) * 100.0 / NULLIF(
            COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_before_warmup_complete), 0
        )
            AS warmup_traffic_or_idle_time_pct,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE is_before_warmup_complete
              AND effective_speed_kmh >= 40 AND tps < 50
        ) * 100.0 / NULLIF(
            COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_before_warmup_complete), 0
        )
            AS warmup_cruise_time_pct,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE is_before_warmup_complete
              AND (tps >= 60 OR map >= 110 OR rpm >= 4000)
        ) * 100.0 / NULLIF(
            COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_before_warmup_complete), 0
        )
            AS warmup_high_load_time_pct,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE is_before_warmup_complete
              AND (oil_temp < 75 OR clt < 75)
              AND (rpm >= 4500 OR map >= 130 OR tps >= 80)
        ) AS cold_engine_abuse_samples_count,

        AVG(ambient_air_density_kg_m3) AS ambient_air_density_kg_m3,
        AVG(manifold_charge_density_kg_m3) FILTER (WHERE is_clean_wot_pull)
            AS wot_manifold_charge_density_kg_m3,
        AVG(effective_charge_density_kg_m3) FILTER (WHERE is_clean_wot_pull)
            AS wot_effective_charge_density_kg_m3,
        AVG(sae_correction_factor) AS sae_correction_factor,
        AVG(imu_longitudinal_accel_g) FILTER (WHERE is_clean_wot_pull)
            AS wot_raw_accel_avg_g,
        MAX(imu_longitudinal_accel_g) FILTER (WHERE is_clean_wot_pull)
            AS wot_raw_accel_max_g,
        AVG(instant_wot_accel_index_g_per_bar) FILTER (WHERE is_clean_wot_pull)
            AS wot_accel_index_g_per_bar,
        AVG(imu_longitudinal_accel_g / NULLIF(map / 100.0, 0))
            FILTER (WHERE is_clean_wot_pull) AS wot_imu_accel_index_g_per_bar,
        AVG(instant_wot_accel_index_g_per_bar
            / NULLIF(manifold_charge_density_kg_m3, 0))
            FILTER (WHERE is_clean_wot_pull) AS wot_boost_weather_efficiency_score,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_clean_wot_pull) AS wot_samples_count,
        COALESCE(SUM(dt_s) FILTER (WHERE is_clean_wot_pull), 0.0)
            AS wot_duration_seconds,

        AVG(timing_ignition) AS avg_ignition_timing_deg,
        MAX(timing_ignition) AS max_ignition_timing_deg,
        AVG(timing_ignition) FILTER (WHERE is_clean_wot_pull)
            AS wot_avg_ignition_timing_deg,
        MIN(timing_ignition) FILTER (WHERE is_clean_wot_pull)
            AS wot_min_ignition_timing_deg,
        AVG(timing_base_ignition) AS avg_base_ignition_timing_deg,
        AVG(dynamic_timing_trim_deg) AS avg_dynamic_timing_trim_deg,
        AVG(dynamic_timing_trim_deg) FILTER (WHERE is_clean_wot_pull)
            AS wot_avg_dynamic_timing_trim_deg,
        MAX(ignition_load) AS max_ignition_load,
        AVG(ignition_load) FILTER (WHERE is_clean_wot_pull) AS wot_avg_ignition_load,
        AVG(ignition_coil_charge_time) AS avg_coil_charge_time_ms,
        MAX(ignition_coil_charge_time) AS max_coil_charge_time_ms,
        AVG(ignition_coil_duty_cycle) AS avg_coil_duty_cycle_pct,
        MAX(ignition_coil_duty_cycle) AS max_coil_duty_cycle_pct,
        AVG(ignition_dwell_deviation) AS avg_dwell_deviation_ms,
        MAX(ABS(ignition_dwell_deviation)) AS max_abs_dwell_deviation_ms,
        MAX(ignition_overcharge_canceled) - MIN(ignition_overcharge_canceled)
            AS overcharge_canceled_delta,
        MAX(ignition_over_dwell_not_scheduled)
            - MIN(ignition_over_dwell_not_scheduled) AS overdwell_not_scheduled_delta,
        MAX(ignition_undecharge_warnings) - MIN(ignition_undecharge_warnings)
            AS ignition_undercharge_warnings_delta,
        MAX(ignition_overcharge_warnings) - MIN(ignition_overcharge_warnings)
            AS ignition_overcharge_warnings_delta,
        MAX(knock_count) - MIN(knock_count) AS knock_events_delta_count,
        MAX(knock_retard) AS max_knock_retard_deg,
        AVG(knock_retard) FILTER (WHERE knock_retard > 0)
            AS avg_active_knock_retard_deg,
        MAX(knock_current_level) AS max_knock_level_dbv,
        AVG(knock_current_level) AS avg_knock_level_dbv,

        AVG(fuel_flow_rate) AS avg_fuel_flow_gps,
        AVG(fuel_flow_rate) * 3.6 / 0.750 AS avg_fuel_flow_lph,
        MAX(fuel_flow_rate) AS max_fuel_flow_gps,
        MAX(fuel_flow_rate) * 3.6 / 0.750 AS max_fuel_flow_lph,
        AVG(fuel_ve) AS avg_ve_pct,
        MAX(fuel_ve) AS max_ve_pct,
        AVG(fuel_ve) FILTER (WHERE is_clean_wot_pull) AS wot_avg_ve_pct,
        MAX(fuel_last_inj_pulse_width) AS max_injector_pulse_width_ms,
        AVG(fuel_last_inj_pulse_width) AS avg_injector_pulse_width_ms,
        MAX(fuel_injector_duty_cycle) AS max_injector_duty_cycle_pct,
        AVG(fuel_injector_duty_cycle) AS avg_injector_duty_cycle_pct,
        AVG(afr) FILTER (
            WHERE rpm >= 500 AND COALESCE(dfco_active, 0) = 0
        ) AS avg_afr,
        AVG(afr) FILTER (WHERE is_clean_wot_pull) AS wot_avg_afr,
        AVG("lambda") FILTER (
            WHERE rpm >= 500 AND COALESCE(dfco_active, 0) = 0
        ) AS avg_lambda,
        AVG("lambda") FILTER (WHERE is_clean_wot_pull) AS wot_avg_lambda,
        MIN("lambda") FILTER (WHERE is_clean_wot_pull) AS wot_min_lambda,
        MAX("lambda") FILTER (WHERE is_clean_wot_pull) AS wot_max_lambda,
        AVG(afr_error) FILTER (
            WHERE rpm >= 500 AND COALESCE(dfco_active, 0) = 0
        ) AS avg_afr_error,
        AVG(afr_error) FILTER (WHERE is_clean_wot_pull) AS wot_avg_afr_error,
        MAX(afr_error) FILTER (WHERE is_clean_wot_pull)
            AS wot_max_lean_spike_afr_error,
        AVG(ego_cor1) FILTER (
            WHERE rpm >= 500 AND COALESCE(dfco_active, 0) = 0
        ) AS avg_ego_cor1_pct,
        MIN(ego_cor1) FILTER (
            WHERE rpm >= 500 AND COALESCE(dfco_active, 0) = 0
        ) AS min_ego_cor1_pct,
        MAX(ego_cor1) FILTER (
            WHERE rpm >= 500 AND COALESCE(dfco_active, 0) = 0
        ) AS max_ego_cor1_pct,
        AVG(stft_bank_1) AS avg_stft_bank1_pct,
        MAX(ABS(stft_bank_1)) AS max_abs_stft_bank1_pct,
        AVG(ltft_bank_1) AS avg_ltft_bank1_pct,
        AVG(fuel_total_correction) AS avg_fuel_total_correction,
        MAX(fuel_total_correction) AS max_fuel_total_correction,
        MAX(fuel_tps_ae_change) AS max_tps_ae_change,
        MAX(fuel_load) AS max_fuel_load,
        AVG(fuel_load) AS avg_fuel_load,
        COALESCE(SUM(dt_s) FILTER (WHERE dfco_active = 1), 0.0)
            AS dfco_duration_seconds,
        COALESCE(SUM(dt_s) FILTER (WHERE dfco_active = 1), 0.0)
            * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(dt_s), 0) AS dfco_time_pct,

        MAX(map) AS max_map_kpa,
        AVG(map) AS avg_map_kpa,
        MAX(effective_map) AS max_effective_map_kpa,
        MAX(boost_gauge_kpa) AS max_boost_gauge_kpa,
        AVG(boost_error_kpa) FILTER (WHERE is_clean_wot_pull)
            AS wot_avg_boost_error_kpa,
        COALESCE(
            MAX(map - boost_target) FILTER (
                WHERE boost_target > COALESCE(NULLIF(baro_pressure, 0), 100.0) + 5.0
                AND tps >= 70.0
                AND map > boost_target
            ),
            0.0
        ) AS max_boost_overshoot_kpa,
        AVG(boost_output) AS avg_boost_output_pct,
        MAX(boost_output) AS max_boost_output_pct,
        AVG(wastegate_position_sensor) AS avg_wastegate_pos_pct,
        MAX(wastegate_position_sensor) AS max_wastegate_pos_pct,

        AVG(NULLIF(baro_pressure, 0)) AS avg_baro_pressure_kpa,

        MAX(effective_speed_kmh) AS max_effective_speed_kmh,
        AVG(effective_speed_kmh) AS avg_effective_speed_kmh,
        MAX(vehicle_speed) AS max_ecu_vehicle_speed_kmh,
        MAX(gps_speed_kmh) AS max_gps_speed_kmh,
        CASE
            WHEN MAX(COALESCE(vehicle_speed, 0)) <= 1.0 THEN 0.0
            ELSE COALESCE(
                COUNT(*) FILTER (
                    WHERE effective_speed_kmh > 2.0 AND vehicle_speed > 1.0
                ) * 100.0
                    / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE effective_speed_kmh > 2.0), 0),
                0.0
            )
        END AS ecu_speed_coverage_pct,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE is_gps_fresh = TRUE AND gps_speed_kmh IS NOT NULL
        ) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS gps_speed_coverage_pct,
        MAX(ABS(wheel_slip_delta_kmh))
            FILTER (WHERE speed_source_mode = 'DUAL_ACTIVE')
            AS max_wheel_slip_delta_kmh,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE speed_source_mode = 'DUAL_ACTIVE'
              AND ABS(wheel_slip_delta_kmh) >= 5
        ) AS wheel_slip_events_count,
        MAX(rpm) AS max_rpm,
        AVG(rpm) AS avg_rpm,
        MAX(d_rpm) AS max_drpm_per_s,
        MAX(tps) AS max_tps_pct,
        AVG(tps) AS avg_tps_pct,
        NULLIF(MAX(throttle_pedal_position), 0) AS max_throttle_pedal_pct,
        SUM(CASE WHEN is_clean_wot_pull THEN COALESCE(dt_s, 0) ELSE 0 END)
            * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(COALESCE(dt_s, 0)), 0) AS wot_time_pct,
        MAX(imu_longitudinal_accel_g) AS max_longitudinal_accel_g,
        MAX(-imu_longitudinal_accel_g)
            FILTER (WHERE imu_longitudinal_accel_g < 0)
            AS max_longitudinal_braking_g,
        MAX(ABS(imu_lateral_accel_g)) AS max_lateral_g,
        MAX(combined_g_force) AS max_combined_g_force,
        AVG(combined_g_force) AS avg_combined_g_force,
        MAX(detected_gear) AS highest_detected_gear
    FROM telemetry_with_warmup
    GROUP BY vehicle_id, drive_id
),
drive_with_dimensions AS (
    SELECT
        metrics.*,
        dim_drive_meta.drive_meta_key,
        dim_weather_conditions.weather_key,
        dim_fuel_profile.fuel_profile_key,
        dim_thermal_profile.thermal_profile_key,
        weather_metrics.total_precipitation_mm,
        weather_metrics.avg_ambient_temp_c,
        weather_metrics.avg_wind_speed_ms,
        CAST(CASE
            WHEN EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM {{ ref('rusefi_error_codes') }} e
                WHERE e.raw_code_id = COALESCE(metrics.first_warning_code, 0)
            ) THEN COALESCE(metrics.first_warning_code, 0)
            ELSE 999
        END AS INTEGER) AS first_warning_code_key,
        CAST(CASE
            WHEN EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM {{ ref('rusefi_error_codes') }} e
                WHERE e.raw_code_id = COALESCE(metrics.last_warning_code, 0)
            ) THEN COALESCE(metrics.last_warning_code, 0)
            ELSE 999
        END AS INTEGER) AS last_warning_code_key,
        CAST(CASE
            WHEN EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM {{ ref('rusefi_error_codes') }} e
                WHERE e.raw_code_id = COALESCE(metrics.stop_engine_code_key_raw, 0)
            ) THEN COALESCE(metrics.stop_engine_code_key_raw, 0)
            ELSE 999
        END AS INTEGER) AS stop_engine_code_key,
        CAST(CASE
            WHEN EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM {{ ref('rusefi_error_codes') }} e
                WHERE e.raw_code_id = COALESCE(metrics.dominant_ign_cut_code_raw, 0)
            ) THEN COALESCE(metrics.dominant_ign_cut_code_raw, 0)
            ELSE 999
        END AS INTEGER) AS dominant_ign_cut_key,
        CAST(CASE
            WHEN EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM {{ ref('rusefi_error_codes') }} e
                WHERE e.raw_code_id = COALESCE(metrics.dominant_fuel_cut_code_raw, 0)
            ) THEN COALESCE(metrics.dominant_fuel_cut_code_raw, 0)
            ELSE 999
        END AS INTEGER) AS dominant_fuel_cut_key
    FROM drive_metrics AS metrics
    LEFT JOIN delta_scan('{{ var("gold_dim_drive_meta_uri") }}') AS dim_drive_meta
      USING (vehicle_id, drive_id)
    LEFT JOIN delta_scan('{{ var("gold_dim_weather_conditions_uri") }}')
        AS dim_weather_conditions USING (vehicle_id, drive_id)
    LEFT JOIN delta_scan('{{ var("gold_dim_fuel_profile_uri") }}') AS dim_fuel_profile
      USING (vehicle_id, drive_id)
    LEFT JOIN delta_scan('{{ var("gold_dim_thermal_profile_uri") }}')
        AS dim_thermal_profile USING (vehicle_id, drive_id)
    LEFT JOIN weather_metrics USING (vehicle_id, drive_id)
)
SELECT
    drive_id,
    vehicle_id,
    drive_meta_key,
    weather_key,
    fuel_profile_key,
    thermal_profile_key,
    first_warning_code_key,
    last_warning_code_key,
    stop_engine_code_key,
    dominant_ign_cut_key,
    dominant_fuel_cut_key,
    error_codes,
    duration_seconds,
    duration_seconds < 300 AS is_repark_or_micro_trip_flag,
    duration_seconds >= 300 AND total_distance_km >= 0.5
        AS is_valid_analytical_drive_flag,
    total_distance_km,
    COALESCE(start_clt_c >= 85, FALSE) AS started_warm_clt_85c_flag,
    COALESCE(start_oil_temp_c >= 82, FALSE) AS started_warm_oil_82c_flag,
    COALESCE(max_clt_c >= 85, FALSE) AS reached_clt_85c_flag,
    COALESCE(max_oil_temp_c >= 82, FALSE) AS reached_oil_82c_flag,
    CASE
        WHEN start_clt_c >= 85 THEN 0.0
        WHEN max_clt_c >= 85 THEN first_clt_85_time_s
    END AS time_to_clt_85c_s,
    CASE
        WHEN start_clt_c >= 85 THEN 0.0
        WHEN max_clt_c >= 85 THEN first_clt_85_distance_km
    END AS distance_to_clt_85c_km,
    CASE
        WHEN start_oil_temp_c >= 82 THEN 0.0
        WHEN max_oil_temp_c >= 82 THEN first_oil_82_time_s
    END AS time_to_oil_82c_s,
    CASE
        WHEN start_oil_temp_c >= 82 THEN 0.0
        WHEN max_oil_temp_c >= 82 THEN first_oil_82_distance_km
    END AS distance_to_oil_82c_km,
    warmup_avg_rpm,
    warmup_max_rpm,
    warmup_avg_map_kpa,
    warmup_avg_tps_pct,
    warmup_avg_speed_kmh,
    warmup_traffic_or_idle_time_pct,
    warmup_cruise_time_pct,
    warmup_high_load_time_pct,
    cold_engine_abuse_samples_count,
    ambient_air_density_kg_m3,
    wot_manifold_charge_density_kg_m3,
    wot_effective_charge_density_kg_m3,
    sae_correction_factor,
    wot_raw_accel_avg_g,
    wot_raw_accel_max_g,
    wot_accel_index_g_per_bar,
    wot_imu_accel_index_g_per_bar,

-- depends_on: "memory"."main"."gold_drive_telemetry"
-- depends_on: "memory"."main"."dim_drive_meta"
-- depends_on: "memory"."main"."dim_weather_conditions"
-- depends_on: "memory"."main"."dim_fuel_profile"
-- depends_on: "memory"."main"."dim_thermal_profile"
-- depends_on: "memory"."main"."dim_rusefi_error_code"

WITH telemetry AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM delta_scan('s3://gold/drive_telemetry')
),
warmup_cutoffs AS (
    SELECT
        vehicle_id,
        drive_id,
        COALESCE(
            MIN(sampled_at) FILTER (WHERE clt >= 85 AND oil_temp >= 82),
            MAX(sampled_at)
        ) AS warmup_complete_timestamp,
        COALESCE(
            ARG_MIN(clt, sampled_at) FILTER (
                WHERE clt BETWEEN -35.0 AND 150.0 AND rpm >= 500
            ),
            ARG_MIN(clt, sampled_at) FILTER (WHERE clt BETWEEN -35.0 AND 150.0)
        ) AS start_clt_c,
        COALESCE(
            ARG_MIN(oil_temp, sampled_at) FILTER (
                WHERE oil_temp BETWEEN -35.0 AND 150.0 AND rpm >= 500
            ),
            ARG_MIN(oil_temp, sampled_at)
                FILTER (WHERE oil_temp BETWEEN -35.0 AND 150.0)
        ) AS start_oil_temp_c
    FROM telemetry
    GROUP BY vehicle_id, drive_id
),
telemetry_with_warmup AS (
    SELECT
        telemetry.*,
        telemetry.sampled_at <= warmup_cutoffs.warmup_complete_timestamp
            AND NOT (
                COALESCE(warmup_cutoffs.start_clt_c >= 85, FALSE)
                AND COALESCE(warmup_cutoffs.start_oil_temp_c >= 82, FALSE)
            )
            AS is_before_warmup_complete
    FROM telemetry
    INNER JOIN warmup_cutoffs USING (vehicle_id, drive_id)
),
gear_steps AS (
    SELECT
        vehicle_id,
        drive_id,
        detected_gear,
        LAG(detected_gear) OVER (
            PARTITION BY vehicle_id, drive_id ORDER BY sampled_at
        ) AS previous_gear
    FROM telemetry
    WHERE detected_gear BETWEEN 1 AND 6
      AND effective_speed_kmh > 5.0
),
gear_stats AS (
    SELECT
        vehicle_id,
        drive_id,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE detected_gear IS NOT NULL
              AND previous_gear IS NOT NULL
              AND detected_gear <> previous_gear
        ) AS gear_shifts_count
    FROM gear_steps
    GROUP BY vehicle_id, drive_id
),
rev_limit_steps AS (
    SELECT
        vehicle_id,
        drive_id,
        rev_limit_active,
        LAG(rev_limit_active) OVER (
            PARTITION BY vehicle_id, drive_id ORDER BY sampled_at
        ) AS previous_rev_limit_active
    FROM telemetry
),
rev_limit_stats AS (
    SELECT
        vehicle_id,
        drive_id,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE rev_limit_active = 1
              AND COALESCE(previous_rev_limit_active, 0) <> 1
        ) AS rev_limit_events_count
    FROM rev_limit_steps
    GROUP BY vehicle_id, drive_id
),
weather_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        vehicle_id,
        drive_id,
        SUM(weather_precipitation_mm) AS total_precipitation_mm,
        AVG(weather_temp_c) AS avg_ambient_temp_c,
        AVG(weather_wind_speed_ms) AS avg_wind_speed_ms
    FROM (
        SELECT
            vehicle_id,
            drive_id,
            weather_hour_bucket,
            AVG(weather_precipitation_mm) AS weather_precipitation_mm,
            AVG(weather_temp_c) AS weather_temp_c,
            AVG(weather_wind_speed_ms) AS weather_wind_speed_ms
        FROM telemetry
        WHERE weather_hour_bucket IS NOT NULL
        GROUP BY vehicle_id, drive_id, weather_hour_bucket
    )
    GROUP BY vehicle_id, drive_id
),
drive_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        vehicle_id,
        drive_id,
        MIN(sampled_at) AS start_timestamp,
        MAX(sampled_at) AS end_timestamp,
        MAX(elapsed_drive_time_s) AS duration_seconds,
        MAX(cumulative_drive_distance_km) AS total_distance_km,
        MAX(fuel_total_consumed) - MIN(fuel_total_consumed)
            AS total_fuel_consumed_g,
        (MAX(fuel_total_consumed) - MIN(fuel_total_consumed)) / 750.0
            AS measured_fuel_l,
        SUM(fuel_flow_rate * dt_s) / 750.0 AS integrated_fuel_l,
        ARG_MIN(warning_last, sampled_at)
            FILTER (WHERE warning_last > 0) AS first_warning_code,
        ARG_MAX(warning_last, sampled_at)
            FILTER (WHERE warning_last > 0) AS last_warning_code,
        ARG_MAX(stop_engine_code, sampled_at)
            FILTER (WHERE stop_engine_code > 0) AS stop_engine_code_key_raw,
        MODE(ign_cut_code) FILTER (WHERE ign_cut_code > 0)
            AS dominant_ign_cut_code_raw,
        MODE(fuel_cut_code) FILTER (WHERE fuel_cut_code > 0)
            AS dominant_fuel_cut_code_raw,
        list_sort(list_distinct(list_concat(
            list(CAST(warning_last AS INTEGER))
                FILTER (WHERE warning_last > 0),
            list(CAST(stop_engine_code AS INTEGER))
                FILTER (WHERE stop_engine_code > 0),
            list(CAST(ign_cut_code AS INTEGER))
                FILTER (WHERE ign_cut_code > 0),
            list(CAST(fuel_cut_code AS INTEGER))
                FILTER (WHERE fuel_cut_code > 0)
        ))) AS error_codes,
        MIN(sampled_at) FILTER (WHERE warning_last > 0) AS first_warning_timestamp,
        MAX(warning_counter) - MIN(warning_counter) AS total_warnings_delta,
        MAX(trigger_error_counter) - MIN(trigger_error_counter)
            AS trigger_errors_delta,
        COALESCE(SUM(dt_s) FILTER (WHERE rev_limit_active = 1), 0.0)
            AS rev_limit_active_duration_s,
        MAX(check_engine) AS check_engine_triggered_flag,
        MAX(total_spark_cut) - MIN(total_spark_cut) AS total_spark_cuts_delta,
        MAX(total_fuel_cut) - MIN(total_fuel_cut) AS total_fuel_cuts_delta,
        MAX(cpu_usage_percent) AS max_cpu_usage_pct,
        AVG(cpu_usage_percent) AS avg_cpu_usage_pct,
        MAX(analog_sensors_supply_failure) AS analog_supply_failure_flag,

        COALESCE(
            ARG_MIN(clt, sampled_at) FILTER (
                WHERE clt BETWEEN -35.0 AND 150.0 AND rpm >= 500
            ),
            ARG_MIN(clt, sampled_at) FILTER (WHERE clt BETWEEN -35.0 AND 150.0)
        ) AS start_clt_c,
        COALESCE(
            ARG_MIN(oil_temp, sampled_at) FILTER (
                WHERE oil_temp BETWEEN -35.0 AND 150.0 AND rpm >= 500
            ),
            ARG_MIN(oil_temp, sampled_at)
                FILTER (WHERE oil_temp BETWEEN -35.0 AND 150.0)
        ) AS start_oil_temp_c,
        MAX(clt) AS max_clt_c,
        MIN(clt) FILTER (WHERE clt > -35.0) AS min_clt_c,
        AVG(clt) AS avg_clt_c,
        AVG(clt) FILTER (WHERE clt > 87.0) AS avg_hot_clt_c,
        COALESCE(
            ARG_MAX(clt, sampled_at) FILTER (
                WHERE clt BETWEEN -35.0 AND 150.0 AND rpm >= 500
            ),
            ARG_MAX(clt, sampled_at) FILTER (WHERE clt BETWEEN -35.0 AND 150.0)
        ) AS end_clt_c,
        MAX(oil_temp) AS max_oil_temp_c,
        MIN(oil_temp) FILTER (WHERE oil_temp > -35.0) AS min_oil_temp_c,
        AVG(oil_temp) AS avg_oil_temp_c,
        AVG(oil_temp) FILTER (WHERE oil_temp > 90.0) AS avg_hot_oil_temp_c,
        COALESCE(
            ARG_MAX(oil_temp, sampled_at) FILTER (
                WHERE oil_temp BETWEEN -35.0 AND 150.0 AND rpm >= 500
            ),
            ARG_MAX(oil_temp, sampled_at)
                FILTER (WHERE oil_temp BETWEEN -35.0 AND 150.0)
        ) AS end_oil_temp_c,
        MAX(mat) AS max_mat_c,
        AVG(mat) AS avg_mat_c,
        AVG(mat) FILTER (WHERE is_clean_wot_pull) AS wot_avg_mat_c,
        MAX(air_charge_temperature_estimate) AS max_charge_temp_est_c,
        AVG(air_charge_temperature_estimate) AS avg_charge_temp_est_c,
        AVG(intercooler_heat_soak_delta_c) AS intercooler_heat_soak_avg_c,
        MAX(intercooler_heat_soak_delta_c) AS intercooler_heat_soak_max_c,
        MAX(mat) FILTER (WHERE rpm >= 500) - MIN(mat) FILTER (WHERE rpm >= 500)
            AS mat_thermal_rise_c,
        MIN(oil_pressure / 100.0) FILTER (
            WHERE oil_temp >= 82.0
              AND is_active_engine_window
              AND rpm >= 650
              AND oil_pressure / 100.0 > 0.1
        )
            AS min_hot_oil_pressure_bar,
        MIN(oil_pressure / 100.0) FILTER (
            WHERE oil_temp >= 82.0
              AND is_active_engine_window
              AND rpm >= 3000
              AND oil_pressure / 100.0 > 0.1
        ) AS min_hot_load_oil_pressure_bar,
        MIN(oil_pressure / 100.0) FILTER (
            WHERE is_active_engine_window
              AND oil_temp >= 80.0
              AND rpm BETWEEN 650 AND 1250
              AND oil_pressure / 100.0 > 0.1
        ) AS min_hot_idle_oil_pressure_bar,
        MIN(oil_pressure_per_1k_rpm_bar) FILTER (
            WHERE is_active_engine_window AND rpm BETWEEN 1500 AND 4000
        ) AS min_oil_pressure_per_1k_rpm_bar,
        AVG(oil_pressure_per_1k_rpm_bar) FILTER (
            WHERE is_active_engine_window AND rpm BETWEEN 1500 AND 4000
        ) AS avg_oil_pressure_per_1k_rpm_bar,
        MIN(oil_pressure_safety_margin_bar) FILTER (
            WHERE is_active_engine_window AND rpm >= 650
        )
            AS min_oil_pressure_safety_margin_bar,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_low_oil_pressure_for_rpm)
            AS low_oil_pressure_samples_count,
        COALESCE(SUM(dt_s) FILTER (WHERE is_low_oil_pressure_for_rpm), 0.0)
            AS low_oil_pressure_duration_s,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE is_low_oil_pressure_for_rpm
              AND ABS(imu_lateral_accel_g) >= 0.35
        ) AS oil_starvation_in_cornering_samples_count,
        CASE
            WHEN COALESCE(
                SUM(dt_s) FILTER (WHERE is_low_oil_pressure_for_rpm),
                0.0
            ) >= 0.15
              OR COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_low_oil_pressure_for_rpm) >= 3
                THEN TRUE
            ELSE FALSE
        END AS low_oil_pressure_damage_risk_flag,
        AVG(oil_pressure / 100.0) FILTER (
            WHERE is_active_engine_window
              AND rpm >= 650
              AND oil_pressure / 100.0 > 0.1
        ) AS avg_oil_pressure_bar,
        MAX(oil_pressure / 100.0) FILTER (
            WHERE is_active_engine_window
              AND rpm >= 650
              AND oil_pressure / 100.0 > 0.1
        ) AS max_oil_pressure_bar,
        MIN(batt_v) FILTER (WHERE rpm >= 500 AND batt_v > 5.0) AS min_batt_v,
        AVG(batt_v) FILTER (WHERE rpm >= 500 AND batt_v > 5.0) AS avg_batt_v,
        MAX(batt_v) AS max_batt_v,
        MAX(ecu_cpu_temperature) AS max_ecu_cpu_temp_c,
        AVG(ecu_cpu_temperature) AS avg_ecu_cpu_temp_c,
        MIN(elapsed_drive_time_s) FILTER (WHERE clt >= 85)
            AS first_clt_85_time_s,
        MIN(cumulative_drive_distance_km) FILTER (WHERE clt >= 85)
            AS first_clt_85_distance_km,
        MIN(elapsed_drive_time_s) FILTER (WHERE oil_temp >= 82)
            AS first_oil_82_time_s,
        MIN(cumulative_drive_distance_km) FILTER (WHERE oil_temp >= 82)

        AVG(rpm) FILTER (WHERE is_before_warmup_complete) AS warmup_avg_rpm,
        MAX(rpm) FILTER (WHERE is_before_warmup_complete) AS warmup_max_rpm,
        AVG(map) FILTER (WHERE is_before_warmup_complete)

        AVG(tps) FILTER (WHERE is_before_warmup_complete)

        AVG(effective_speed_kmh) FILTER (WHERE is_before_warmup_complete)

        COUNT(*) FILTER (

        COUNT(*) FILTER (

        AVG(ambient_air_density_kg_m3) AS ambient_air_density_kg_m3,

        MIN("lambda") FILTER (WHERE is_clean_wot_pull) AS wot_min_lambda,
        MAX("lambda") FILTER (WHERE is_clean_wot_pull) AS wot_max_lambda,
        AVG(afr_error) FILTER (
            WHERE rpm >= 500 AND COALESCE(dfco_active, 0) = 0
        ) AS avg_afr_error,
        AVG(afr_error) FILTER (WHERE is_clean_wot_pull) AS wot_avg_afr_error,
        MAX(afr_error) FILTER (WHERE is_clean_wot_pull)
            AS wot_max_lean_spike_afr_error,
        AVG(ego_cor1) FILTER (
            WHERE rpm >= 500 AND COALESCE(dfco_active, 0) = 0
        ) AS avg_ego_cor1_pct,
        MIN(ego_cor1) FILTER (
            WHERE rpm >= 500 AND COALESCE(dfco_active, 0) = 0
        ) AS min_ego_cor1_pct,
        MAX(ego_cor1) FILTER (
            WHERE rpm >= 500 AND COALESCE(dfco_active, 0) = 0
        ) AS max_ego_cor1_pct,
        AVG(stft_bank_1) AS avg_stft_bank1_pct,
        MAX(ABS(stft_bank_1)) AS max_abs_stft_bank1_pct,
        AVG(ltft_bank_1) AS avg_ltft_bank1_pct,
        AVG(fuel_total_correction) AS avg_fuel_total_correction,
        MAX(fuel_total_correction) AS max_fuel_total_correction,
        MAX(fuel_tps_ae_change) AS max_tps_ae_change,
        MAX(fuel_load) AS max_fuel_load,
        AVG(fuel_load) AS avg_fuel_load,
        COALESCE(SUM(dt_s) FILTER (WHERE dfco_active = 1), 0.0)
            AS dfco_duration_seconds,
        COALESCE(SUM(dt_s) FILTER (WHERE dfco_active = 1), 0.0)
            * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(dt_s), 0) AS dfco_time_pct,

        MAX(map) AS max_map_kpa,
        AVG(map) AS avg_map_kpa,
        MAX(effective_map) AS max_effective_map_kpa,
        MAX(boost_gauge_kpa) AS max_boost_gauge_kpa,
        AVG(boost_error_kpa) FILTER (WHERE is_clean_wot_pull)
            AS wot_avg_boost_error_kpa,
        COALESCE(
            MAX(map - boost_target) FILTER (
                WHERE boost_target > COALESCE(NULLIF(baro_pressure, 0), 100.0) + 5.0
                AND tps >= 70.0
                AND map > boost_target
            ),
            0.0
        ) AS max_boost_overshoot_kpa,
        AVG(boost_output) AS avg_boost_output_pct,
        MAX(boost_output) AS max_boost_output_pct,
        AVG(wastegate_position_sensor) AS avg_wastegate_pos_pct,
        MAX(wastegate_position_sensor) AS max_wastegate_pos_pct,

        AVG(NULLIF(baro_pressure, 0)) AS avg_baro_pressure_kpa,

        MAX(effective_speed_kmh) AS max_effective_speed_kmh,
        AVG(effective_speed_kmh) AS avg_effective_speed_kmh,
        MAX(vehicle_speed) AS max_ecu_vehicle_speed_kmh,
        MAX(gps_speed_kmh) AS max_gps_speed_kmh,
        CASE
            WHEN MAX(COALESCE(vehicle_speed, 0)) <= 1.0 THEN 0.0
            ELSE COALESCE(
                COUNT(*) FILTER (
                    WHERE effective_speed_kmh > 2.0 AND vehicle_speed > 1.0
                ) * 100.0
                    / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE effective_speed_kmh > 2.0), 0),
                0.0
            )
        END AS ecu_speed_coverage_pct,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE is_gps_fresh = TRUE AND gps_speed_kmh IS NOT NULL
        ) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS gps_speed_coverage_pct,
        MAX(ABS(wheel_slip_delta_kmh))
            FILTER (WHERE speed_source_mode = 'DUAL_ACTIVE')
            AS max_wheel_slip_delta_kmh,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE speed_source_mode = 'DUAL_ACTIVE'
              AND ABS(wheel_slip_delta_kmh) >= 5
        ) AS wheel_slip_events_count,
        MAX(rpm) AS max_rpm,
        AVG(rpm) AS avg_rpm,
        MAX(d_rpm) AS max_drpm_per_s,
        MAX(tps) AS max_tps_pct,
        AVG(tps) AS avg_tps_pct,
        NULLIF(MAX(throttle_pedal_position), 0) AS max_throttle_pedal_pct,
        SUM(CASE WHEN is_clean_wot_pull THEN COALESCE(dt_s, 0) ELSE 0 END)
            * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(COALESCE(dt_s, 0)), 0) AS wot_time_pct,
        MAX(imu_longitudinal_accel_g) AS max_longitudinal_accel_g,
        MAX(-imu_longitudinal_accel_g)
            FILTER (WHERE imu_longitudinal_accel_g < 0)
            AS max_longitudinal_braking_g,
        MAX(ABS(imu_lateral_accel_g)) AS max_lateral_g,
        MAX(combined_g_force) AS max_combined_g_force,
        AVG(combined_g_force) AS avg_combined_g_force,
        MAX(detected_gear) AS highest_detected_gear
    FROM telemetry_with_warmup
    GROUP BY vehicle_id, drive_id
),
drive_with_dimensions AS (

model.dbt_cloudmetry.gold_drive_telemetr.raw_code:
{{
    config(
        materialized='external',
        plugin='delta_merge',
        format='parquet',
        location=var('dbt_staging_uri') ~ '/' ~ var('batch_id') ~ '_gold_drive_telemetry.parquet',
        options={},
        delta_merge_options={
            'location': var('gold_telemetry_uri'),
            'key_columns': ['vehicle_id', 'drive_id', 'source_time_s'],
            'partition_by': ['event_date']
        }
    )
}}

-- depends_on: {{ ref('silver_accelerometer') }}
-- depends_on: {{ ref('silver_telemetry') }}
-- depends_on: {{ ref('silver_gps') }}

{% set telemetry_fields = var('telemetry_columns') %}

WITH affected_drives AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT vehicle_id, drive_id
    FROM {{ ref('stg_bronze_deduped') }}
    WHERE stream IN ('gps', 'telemetry', 'accelerometer')
),
accelerometer AS (
    SELECT source.*
    FROM delta_scan('{{ var("silver_accelerometer_uri") }}') AS source
    WHERE (vehicle_id, drive_id) IN (
        SELECT vehicle_id, drive_id FROM affected_drives
    )
),
telemetry AS (
    SELECT source.*
    FROM delta_scan('{{ var("silver_telemetry_uri") }}') AS source
    WHERE (vehicle_id, drive_id) IN (
        SELECT vehicle_id, drive_id FROM affected_drives
    )
),
gps AS (
    SELECT source.*
    FROM delta_scan('{{ var("silver_gps_uri") }}') AS source
    WHERE (vehicle_id, drive_id) IN (
        SELECT vehicle_id, drive_id FROM affected_drives
    )
),
weather AS (
    SELECT source.*
    FROM delta_scan('{{ var("silver_weather_uri") }}') AS source
),
joined AS (
    SELECT
        accelerometer.vehicle_id,
        accelerometer.drive_id,
        accelerometer.source_time_s,
        accelerometer.sampled_at,
        TRY_CAST(accelerometer.sampled_at AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AS sampled_at_ts,
        accelerometer.event_date,
        accelerometer.x_g AS accel_x_g,
        accelerometer.y_g AS accel_y_g,
        accelerometer.z_g AS accel_z_g,
        accelerometer.source_file AS accelerometer_source_file,
        telemetry.source_time_s AS telemetry_source_time_s,
        telemetry.sampled_at AS telemetry_sampled_at,
        telemetry.source_file AS telemetry_source_file,
        {% for col in telemetry_fields %}
        telemetry."{{ col }}" AS "{{ col }}"{% if not loop.last %},{% endif %}
        {% endfor %},
        gps.source_time_s AS gps_source_time_s,
        gps.sampled_at AS gps_sampled_at,
        gps.latitude AS gps_latitude,
        gps.longitude AS gps_longitude,
        gps.recorded_at AS gps_recorded_at,
        gps.heading_deg AS gps_heading_deg,
        gps.speed_kph AS gps_speed_kmh,
        gps.lat_grid AS gps_lat_grid,
        gps.lon_grid AS gps_lon_grid,
        gps.hour_bucket AS gps_hour_bucket,
        gps.weather_hour_bucket,
        COALESCE(gps.temperature_2m, weather.temperature_2m) AS weather_temp_c,
        COALESCE(gps.precipitation, weather.precipitation)
            AS weather_precipitation_mm,
        COALESCE(gps.surface_pressure_hpa, weather.surface_pressure_hpa)
            AS weather_pressure_hpa,
        COALESCE(gps.relative_humidity_2m, weather.relative_humidity_2m)
            AS weather_relative_humidity_pct,
        weather.wind_speed_10m AS weather_wind_speed_ms,
        gps.source_file AS gps_source_file
    FROM accelerometer
    ASOF LEFT JOIN telemetry
      ON accelerometer.vehicle_id = telemetry.vehicle_id
     AND accelerometer.drive_id = telemetry.drive_id
     AND accelerometer.source_time_s >= telemetry.source_time_s
    ASOF LEFT JOIN gps
      ON accelerometer.vehicle_id = gps.vehicle_id
     AND accelerometer.drive_id = gps.drive_id
     AND accelerometer.source_time_s >= gps.source_time_s
    LEFT JOIN weather
      ON gps.lat_grid = weather.lat_grid
     AND gps.lon_grid = weather.lon_grid
     AND gps.hour_bucket = weather.hour_bucket
),
aged AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        (source_time_s - telemetry_source_time_s) * 1000.0
            AS telemetry_sample_age_ms,
        (source_time_s - gps_source_time_s) * 1000.0 AS gps_sample_age_ms,
        date_diff(
            'millisecond',
            weather_hour_bucket,
            timezone('Europe/Warsaw', sampled_at_ts)
        ) / 1000.0 AS weather_sample_age_seconds
    FROM joined
),
freshness AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        COALESCE(telemetry_sample_age_ms BETWEEN 0 AND 500, FALSE)
            AS is_telemetry_fresh,
        COALESCE(gps_sample_age_ms BETWEEN 0 AND 2000, FALSE)
            AS is_gps_fresh,
        COALESCE(
            ABS(weather_sample_age_seconds) <= 7200
                OR weather_temp_c IS NOT NULL,
            FALSE
        ) AS is_weather_fresh
    FROM aged
),
cleaned AS (
    SELECT
        * EXCLUDE (
            {% for col in telemetry_fields %}
            "{{ col }}"{% if not loop.last %}, {% endif %}
            {% endfor %},
            gps_latitude,
            gps_longitude,
            gps_heading_deg,
            gps_speed_kmh,
            gps_lat_grid,
            gps_lon_grid,
            weather_temp_c,
            weather_precipitation_mm,
            weather_pressure_hpa,
            weather_relative_humidity_pct,
            weather_wind_speed_ms
        ),
        {% for col in telemetry_fields %}
        CASE WHEN is_telemetry_fresh THEN "{{ col }}" END AS "{{ col }}",
        {% endfor %}
        CASE WHEN is_gps_fresh THEN gps_latitude END AS gps_latitude,
        CASE WHEN is_gps_fresh THEN gps_longitude END AS gps_longitude,
        CASE WHEN is_gps_fresh THEN gps_heading_deg END AS gps_heading_deg,
        CASE WHEN is_gps_fresh THEN gps_speed_kmh END AS gps_speed_kmh,
        CASE WHEN is_gps_fresh THEN gps_lat_grid END AS gps_lat_grid,
        CASE WHEN is_gps_fresh THEN gps_lon_grid END AS gps_lon_grid,
        CASE WHEN is_weather_fresh THEN weather_temp_c END AS weather_temp_c,
        CASE WHEN is_weather_fresh THEN weather_precipitation_mm END
            AS weather_precipitation_mm,
        CASE WHEN is_weather_fresh THEN weather_pressure_hpa END
            AS weather_pressure_hpa,
        CASE WHEN is_weather_fresh THEN weather_relative_humidity_pct END
            AS weather_relative_humidity_pct,
        CASE WHEN is_weather_fresh THEN weather_wind_speed_ms END
            AS weather_wind_speed_ms
    FROM freshness
),
speed_presence AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        MAX(COALESCE(vehicle_speed, 0)) OVER (
            PARTITION BY vehicle_id, drive_id
        ) > 5.0 AS has_ecu_speed,
        MAX(COALESCE(gps_speed_kmh, 0)) OVER (
            PARTITION BY vehicle_id, drive_id
        ) > 5.0 AS has_gps_speed
    FROM cleaned
),
speed_choice AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        CASE
            WHEN has_ecu_speed AND has_gps_speed THEN 'DUAL_ACTIVE'
            WHEN NOT has_ecu_speed AND has_gps_speed THEN 'GPS_ONLY'
            WHEN has_ecu_speed AND NOT has_gps_speed THEN 'ECU_VSS_ONLY'
            ELSE 'NO_VALID_SPEED'
        END AS speed_source_mode,
        CASE
            WHEN has_gps_speed AND is_gps_fresh AND gps_speed_kmh > 0
                THEN gps_speed_kmh
            WHEN has_ecu_speed THEN COALESCE(vehicle_speed, 0.0)
            ELSE COALESCE(gps_speed_kmh, vehicle_speed, 0.0)
        END AS effective_speed_kmh,
        CASE
            WHEN has_gps_speed AND is_gps_fresh AND gps_speed_kmh > 0
                THEN gps_source_time_s
            WHEN has_ecu_speed THEN telemetry_source_time_s
            WHEN gps_speed_kmh IS NOT NULL THEN gps_source_time_s
            ELSE telemetry_source_time_s
        END AS effective_speed_source_time_s,
        CASE
            WHEN has_ecu_speed AND has_gps_speed AND is_gps_fresh
                THEN vehicle_speed - gps_speed_kmh
        END AS wheel_slip_delta_kmh
    FROM speed_presence
),
distance_steps AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        CASE
            WHEN source_time_s - LAG(source_time_s) OVER (
                PARTITION BY vehicle_id, drive_id
                ORDER BY sampled_at_ts, source_time_s
            ) BETWEEN 0.001 AND 1.0
                THEN source_time_s - LAG(source_time_s) OVER (
                    PARTITION BY vehicle_id, drive_id
                    ORDER BY sampled_at_ts, source_time_s
                )
            ELSE 0.02
        END AS dt_s
    FROM speed_choice
),
distances AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        effective_speed_kmh / 3600.0 * dt_s AS step_distance_km,
        SUM(effective_speed_kmh / 3600.0 * dt_s) OVER (
            PARTITION BY vehicle_id, drive_id
            ORDER BY sampled_at_ts, source_time_s
            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS cumulative_drive_distance_km,
        date_diff(
            'millisecond',
            MIN(sampled_at_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY vehicle_id, drive_id),
            sampled_at_ts
        ) / 1000.0 AS elapsed_drive_time_s,
        (effective_speed_kmh - LAG(effective_speed_kmh) OVER (
            PARTITION BY vehicle_id, drive_id
            ORDER BY sampled_at_ts, source_time_s
        )) / 3.6 / NULLIF(dt_s, 0) / 9.80665 AS row_speed_deriv_accel_g
    FROM distance_steps
),
speed_update_rows AS (
    SELECT
        vehicle_id,
        drive_id,
        effective_speed_source_time_s AS speed_update_time_s,
        effective_speed_kmh,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY vehicle_id, drive_id, effective_speed_source_time_s
            ORDER BY sampled_at_ts, source_time_s
        ) AS update_row_number
    FROM distances
    WHERE effective_speed_source_time_s IS NOT NULL
),
speed_updates AS (
    SELECT
        vehicle_id,
        drive_id,
        speed_update_time_s,
        effective_speed_kmh,
        LAG(effective_speed_kmh) OVER (
            PARTITION BY vehicle_id, drive_id ORDER BY speed_update_time_s
        ) AS lagged_speed_kmh,
        LAG(speed_update_time_s) OVER (
            PARTITION BY vehicle_id, drive_id ORDER BY speed_update_time_s
        ) AS lagged_speed_time_s
    FROM speed_update_rows
    WHERE update_row_number = 1
),
derived AS (
    SELECT
        distances.*,
        (speed_updates.effective_speed_kmh - speed_updates.lagged_speed_kmh)
            / 3.6
            / NULLIF(
                speed_updates.speed_update_time_s - speed_updates.lagged_speed_time_s,
                0
            )
            / 9.80665 AS speed_deriv_accel_g
    FROM distances
    LEFT JOIN speed_updates
      ON distances.vehicle_id = speed_updates.vehicle_id
     AND distances.drive_id = speed_updates.drive_id
     AND distances.effective_speed_source_time_s = speed_updates.speed_update_time_s
),
imu_offsets AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        MEDIAN(accel_y_g) FILTER (
            WHERE effective_speed_kmh < 1.0 AND ABS(accel_y_g) <= 1.8
        ) OVER (PARTITION BY vehicle_id, drive_id) AS stationary_longitudinal_offset_g,
        MEDIAN(accel_x_g) FILTER (
            WHERE effective_speed_kmh < 1.0 AND ABS(accel_x_g) <= 1.8
        ) OVER (PARTITION BY vehicle_id, drive_id) AS stationary_lateral_offset_g
    FROM derived
),
imu_filtered AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        CASE
            WHEN ABS(accel_y_g) <= 1.8
                THEN accel_y_g - COALESCE(stationary_longitudinal_offset_g, 0.0)
        END AS calibrated_longitudinal_accel_g,
        CASE
            WHEN ABS(accel_x_g) <= 1.8
                THEN accel_x_g - COALESCE(stationary_lateral_offset_g, 0.0)
        END AS calibrated_lateral_accel_g
    FROM imu_offsets
),
imu_smoothed AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        AVG(calibrated_longitudinal_accel_g) OVER (
            PARTITION BY vehicle_id, drive_id
            ORDER BY sampled_at_ts, source_time_s
            ROWS BETWEEN 10 PRECEDING AND 10 FOLLOWING
        ) AS smoothed_longitudinal_accel_g,
        AVG(calibrated_lateral_accel_g) OVER (
            PARTITION BY vehicle_id, drive_id
            ORDER BY sampled_at_ts, source_time_s
            ROWS BETWEEN 10 PRECEDING AND 10 FOLLOWING
        ) AS smoothed_lateral_accel_g
    FROM imu_filtered
),
wot_state AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        COALESCE((
            effective_speed_kmh >= 30.0
            AND tps >= 85.0
            AND ABS(COALESCE(d_tps, 0)) < 15.0
            AND COALESCE(d_rpm, 0) > 200.0
            AND COALESCE(total_spark_cut, 0) = 0
            AND COALESCE(total_fuel_cut, 0) = 0
            AND COALESCE(rev_limit_active, 0) = 0
        ), FALSE) AS is_clean_wot_pull
    FROM imu_smoothed
),
imu_alignment AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        AVG(smoothed_longitudinal_accel_g * speed_deriv_accel_g) FILTER (
            WHERE is_clean_wot_pull
              AND COALESCE(d_rpm, 0) > 300
              AND COALESCE(tps, 0) > 50
              AND speed_deriv_accel_g IS NOT NULL
        ) OVER (PARTITION BY vehicle_id, drive_id) AS imu_longitudinal_alignment_score
    FROM wot_state
),
aligned_imu AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        CASE
            WHEN imu_longitudinal_alignment_score < 0
                THEN -smoothed_longitudinal_accel_g
            ELSE smoothed_longitudinal_accel_g
        END AS imu_longitudinal_accel_g,
        smoothed_lateral_accel_g AS imu_lateral_accel_g
    FROM imu_alignment
),
gforce AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        SQRT(
            POWER(imu_longitudinal_accel_g, 2)
            + POWER(imu_lateral_accel_g, 2)
        ) AS combined_g_force,
        COALESCE(speed_deriv_accel_g, imu_longitudinal_accel_g)
            AS effective_longitudinal_accel_g
    FROM aligned_imu
),
ambient_inputs AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(baro_pressure, 0),
            NULLIF(weather_pressure_hpa / 10.0, 0),
            101.325
        ) AS effective_baro_kpa,
        COALESCE(
            weather_temp_c,
            MIN(NULLIF(mat, 0)) OVER (PARTITION BY vehicle_id, drive_id),
            20.0
        ) AS effective_ambient_temp_c
    FROM gforce
),
drive_windows AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        MAX(elapsed_drive_time_s) OVER (
            PARTITION BY vehicle_id, drive_id
        ) AS max_drive_time_s,
        MIN(elapsed_drive_time_s) FILTER (WHERE rpm >= 650) OVER (
            PARTITION BY vehicle_id, drive_id
        ) AS first_engine_running_time_s,
        MAX(elapsed_drive_time_s) FILTER (WHERE rpm >= 650) OVER (
            PARTITION BY vehicle_id, drive_id
        ) AS last_engine_running_time_s
    FROM ambient_inputs
),
active_engine_windows AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        COALESCE(
            rpm >= 650
                AND elapsed_drive_time_s > first_engine_running_time_s + 2.0
                AND elapsed_drive_time_s < last_engine_running_time_s - 1.0,
            FALSE
        ) AS is_active_engine_window
    FROM drive_windows
),
oil_pressure_targets AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        CASE
            WHEN NOT is_active_engine_window OR rpm < 650 THEN NULL
            WHEN rpm < 900 THEN 1.00
            WHEN rpm < 4000 THEN 1.00 + 0.71 * ((rpm - 900.0) / 1000.0)
            ELSE 3.20
        END AS min_safe_oil_pressure_target_bar,
        CASE
            WHEN is_active_engine_window
              AND rpm >= 650
              AND oil_pressure / 100.0 > 0.1
                THEN (oil_pressure / 100.0) / (rpm / 1000.0)
        END AS oil_pressure_per_1k_rpm_bar
    FROM active_engine_windows
),
metrics AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        afr - fuel_target_afr AS afr_error,
        "lambda" - fuel_target_lambda AS lambda_error,
        map - effective_baro_kpa AS boost_gauge_kpa,
        map - boost_target AS boost_error_kpa,
        timing_ignition - timing_base_ignition AS dynamic_timing_trim_deg,
        (effective_baro_kpa * 1000.0)
            / (287.05 * (effective_ambient_temp_c + 273.15))
            AS ambient_air_density_kg_m3,
        (map * 1000.0) / (287.05 * (NULLIF(mat, 0) + 273.15))
            AS manifold_charge_density_kg_m3,
        (effective_map * 1000.0)
            / (
                287.05
                * (NULLIF(air_charge_temperature_estimate, 0) + 273.15)
            )
            AS effective_charge_density_kg_m3,
        1.180 * (
            (99.0 / effective_baro_kpa)
            * SQRT((effective_ambient_temp_c + 273.15) / 298.15)
        ) - 0.180 AS sae_correction_factor,
        mat - weather_temp_c AS intercooler_heat_soak_delta_c
    FROM oil_pressure_targets
),
oil_pressure_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        CASE
            WHEN is_active_engine_window
              AND rpm >= 650
              AND oil_pressure / 100.0 > 0.1
                THEN oil_pressure / 100.0 - min_safe_oil_pressure_target_bar
        END AS oil_pressure_safety_margin_bar,
        CASE
            WHEN is_active_engine_window
              AND rpm >= 650
              AND oil_pressure / 100.0 > 0.1
              AND oil_pressure / 100.0 < min_safe_oil_pressure_target_bar
                THEN TRUE
            ELSE FALSE
        END AS is_low_oil_pressure_for_rpm
    FROM metrics
),
final_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        CASE
            WHEN is_clean_wot_pull AND map > 0
                THEN imu_longitudinal_accel_g / (map / 100.0)
        END AS instant_wot_accel_index_g_per_bar
    FROM oil_pressure_metrics
)
SELECT

### Welcome!

Welcome to the auto-generated documentation for your dbt project!

### Navigation

You can use the `Project` and `Database` navigation tabs on the left side of the window to explore the models
in your project.

#### Project Tab
The `Project` tab mirrors the directory structure of your dbt project. In this tab, you can see all of the
models defined in your dbt project, as well as models imported from dbt packages.

#### Database Tab
The `Database` tab also exposes your models, but in a format that looks more like a database explorer. This view
shows relations (tables and views) grouped into database schemas. Note that ephemeral models are _not_ shown
in this interface, as they do not exist in the database.

### Graph Exploration
You can click the blue icon on the bottom-right corner of the page to view the lineage graph of your models.

On model pages, you'll see the immediate parents and children of the model you're exploring. By clicking the `Expand`
button at the top-right of this lineage pane, you'll be able to see all of the models that are used to build,
or are built from, the model you're exploring.

Once expanded, you'll be able to use the `--select` and `--exclude` model selection syntax to filter the
models in the graph. For more information on model selection, check out the [dbt docs](https://docs.getdbt.com/docs/model-selection-syntax).

Note that you can also right-click on models to interactively filter and explore the graph.
